# Morgan Nuttall (Uncle LYHME) Personal Site

> Canonical URL: https://unclelyh.me

## Overview
Personal portfolio website for Morgan Nuttall, known online as Uncle LYHME (developer, infrastructure & platform engineer, and prompt engineer experienced with Claude Code and Codex). The site presents profile details, experience, skills, social links, and selected projects.

## Audience
- Recruiters and hiring managers
- Potential clients and collaborators
- Community members looking for projects/contact info

## Main Content Areas
- About / personal summary
- Current focus and activities
- Professional experience history
- Skills and tooling
- Featured projects
- Contact and social profiles

## Technical Notes
- Static site (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- Main files: `index.html`, `assets/css/tokens.css`, `assets/css/layout.css`, `assets/css/components.css`, `assets/js/main.js`
- SEO assets: `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`
- Machine-readable discovery resources are published from static files in `.well-known/`
